$description: Not in Figma: the tokens the components already paint or need, which Figma has no variables for yet (intent and state colours, focus, opacity, layers) and the font variables Figma binds on every text node but the drawing-based pull never reads. Written by hand (DTCG 2025.10); npm run tokens:pull never touches this file, npm run tokens:build merges it with the Figma tokens by token path. A path Figma gains must leave this file (the build refuses it twice). Figma ids are in $extensions com.figma.variableId and in tokens/variable-ids.json.

navy-10.$description: Navy 650 at 10%. Primitive: paint with surface-selected.

red-12.$description: Red 500 at 12%. Primitive: paint with surface-danger.

red-16.$description: Red 500 at 16%. Primitive: paint with surface-danger-pressed.

amber-14.$description: Amber 600 at 14%. Primitive: paint with surface-warning.

amber-30.$description: Amber 600 at 30%. Primitive: paint with border-warning.

green-30.$description: Green 400 at 30%. Primitive: paint with border-success.

selected.$description: A selected row, cell or range: the brand at 10% over the panel. Rows, list rows, the data table, the range calendar.

neutral-hovered.$description: A neutral fill under the pointer: a pill-shaped Select or chip hovered.

danger.$description: A danger tint: the alert dialog's icon badge, a quiet danger button hovered.

danger-pressed.$description: The danger tint pressed: a quiet danger button held down.

warning.$description: A warning tint: a warning Banner, the side panel's warning strip.

success-strong.$description: The solid success fill: the tick in a success Toast.

inverse.$description: The near-black fill that inverts the page: a Switch that is on, a selected toggle button. Text and icons on it are text-inverse and icon-inverse.

disabled.$description: A field or control that can't be used: a disabled Text field's fill.

danger.$description: Danger words: a danger button's label, a field error, a negative trend, a count of new items that needs action.

info.$description: Info words on surface-info: an info Badge.

brand.$description: Brand words that are not links: "new" markers, ranks, badges, the current page number.

danger.$description: A danger icon: the alert dialog's badge, a danger button's icon.

brand.$description: A brand icon: a check in a selected option, a selected menu item's tick, an active filter's icon.

disabled.$description: An icon in a control that can't be used.

danger.$description: An invalid field or control's border.

warning.$description: The edge of a warning tint: the side panel's warning strip.

success.$description: The edge of a success tint: a success Toast and its action.

disabled.$description: The border of a control that can't be used.

focused.$description: The keyboard focus ring's colour. Components draw the whole ring with --gv-focus-ring.

highlight.$description: Chart: the one thing a finding names, in the accent: a highlighted bar, a highlighted figure (Stat tile's isHighlighted, a document's lead number). Not in Figma; the same teal as surface-accent-strong.

icon-accent.$description: Side nav only (component tier): an icon in the accent green on the dark nav (the Support row).

border-focused.$description: Side nav only (component tier): the keyboard focus ring on the dark nav, where border-focused would vanish. Drawn as var(--gv-border-width-2) solid, inset.

ring.$description: The keyboard focus ring: outline: var(--gv-focus-ring) on [data-focus-visible], with --gv-focus-ring-offset outside the box or --gv-focus-ring-offset-inset inside it.

ring-offset.$description: The focus ring's gap outside the box: outline-offset for anything with room around it.

ring-offset-inset.$description: The focus ring drawn inside the box: outline-offset for rows, tabs and cells that touch their neighbours.

1.$description: A hairline: borders, dividers, rows. Writing 1px is fine too; the token matches Figma's stroke variable.

2.$description: A strong stroke: the focus ring, a selected card's edge.

disabled.$description: Anything that can't be used, drawn at 45% (docs/DECISIONS.md).

dragging.$description: A row or item while it is dragged.

dimmed.$description: What steps back while another series is picked out: a legend item, a bar, a legend row.

sticky.$description: z-index of what sticks while its content scrolls: a table's header.

panel.$description: z-index of a non-modal panel over the page: the side panel.

overlay.$description: z-index of what floats over everything: modals, toasts.

family.$description: The one typeface. Every text style uses it; set it through a type role (font: var(--gv-type-<role>)), not on its own.

family-document.$description: Not in Figma: the typeface of a document people read or print (a report's pages), set through the document roles (font: var(--gv-type-document-<role>)). The interface's family by default; a platform's theme sets this one at :root to give its documents its own face while the interface keeps Public Sans.

size-12.$description: Small and Small strong: captions, meta, pills, labels.

size-13.$description: UI and UI strong: the control size (buttons, rows, menus, cells).

size-14.$description: Body and Body strong: reading text, modal titles.

size-16.$description: Title: panel, modal and card titles.

size-19.$description: Not in Figma: Document lead, a document's opening line and a figure's finding.

size-20.$description: Stat small: small number tiles and counts.

size-28.$description: Stat: big numbers in KPI tiles.

size-44.$description: Not in Figma: Document display, a document's title on its title page.

line-height-28.$description: Not in Figma: the line under 19px text.

line-height-36.$description: Not in Figma: the line under 28px document headings.

line-height-52.$description: Not in Figma: the line under 44px text.

weight-medium.$description: Medium (500): the strong roles and titles. To make a role's text medium: font-weight: var(--gv-font-weight-medium).

tracking.$description: The one letter spacing, 0px, set once on :root (theme.css) and inherited by every element and form control. No role tracks its own.

document-display.$description: Not in Figma: a document's title on its title page (a report's cover). 44/52 Medium.

document-heading.$description: Not in Figma: a document's section heading on its page (a report's numbered section). 28/36 Medium.

document-lead.$description: Not in Figma: a document's lead line: the title page's subtitle, a figure's finding, an insight's question. 19/28 Regular.

document-body.$description: Not in Figma: a document's reading text on its page (a report's paragraphs and lists, a quote's words). 13/20 Regular.

40.$description: Not in Figma yet (Figma has 44; code snapped it to 40, what the prototype drew): a section's padding on a page, an empty state's room.

64.$description: Not in Figma, unused for now: the next step on the ladder, so it has no hole.
